Full Press Release

Philippine Global Media Group to Hold its Induction/Gala Night Aug. 8

On its third year as an active press organization, the Philippine Global Media Group (PGMG) will hold its Induction of Officers and Gala Night on August 8 (Saturday) at 6:00 PM at the Crystal Ballroom of the Sheraton Cerritos Hotel at 12725 Center Court Drive, Cerritos.

This was announced by its incoming president Dan Estabillo Nino and Val G. Abelgas, president and board chairman respectively of PGMG, a City of Cerritos-based public benefit 501 C-3 nonprofit corporation.

Mr. Nino, a lifelong journalist, will succeed Mr. Abelgas, also a seasoned journalist, who will serve as chairman of the board. Nino began his media career in Manila in 1973 as contributing writer for Sports Weekly Magazine and Mod Magazine before becoming the managing editor of Car & Truck Magazine. He also worked with Landloil Resources Corporation as assistant for public relations and head of public affairs of Philippine Cellophane Film Corporation. He also freelances for Philippine News Today, Asian Journal, Balikbayan Magazine, Weekend Balita, and the Philippine Post. He was also a past president of the now-defunct Filipino-American Press Club of Los Angeles. Recently, he was conferred the 2026 TOP (The Outstanding Pilipino) Award for his achievement in the field of Journalism.

Val Abelgas, who was the first president of PGMG, is the publisher and editor-in-chief of Philippine Post, a digital weekly. He has been a professional journalist for 54 years starting as a sportswriter of Philippine Daily Express before becoming its managing editor. He was also the first TOP Awardee for Outstanding Achievement in Journalism in 2018 and the first FAPCCA Journalist of the Year in 2016.

Other officers to be sworn in by Philippine Consul General to Los Angeles Adelio Angelito S. Cruz include vice presidents Lydia V. Solis, Nimfa U. Rueda, Jannelle So-Perkins; Donna Gatdula-Arevalo (secretary); Meg Ilagan (treasurer); Rick Gavino (Auditor); Ellen Rodriguez-Swing and Joe T. Cobilla, Jr. (public relations officers); along with board members Marc Pijuan, Louinn Lota, Alfred G. Gabot, Meh M. Guevarra, Bobby Crisostomo, Julian Oriel, Vics Magsaysay, Joy Marino, Doeleth Gatdula, Nemen Cabatuando, Benny Uy, Isidric M. Panganiban, Mylene K. Capati, Fernando Gonong Jr., Eddie C. Ferrer, and Mel T. Velasco.

The Philippine Global Media Group was founded in November 2023 by Manny Ilagan, Val Abelgas, Lydia Solis, and Nimfa Rueda — to serve as an entity to unite the various practitioners in print, broadcast, and digital media with the mission of uplifting the journalistic and ethical standards among men and women initially in Southern California — with an eye to expanding the group to include media practitioners in the global Filipino diaspora.

Among its initial accomplishments were: spearheading the book launching of "California: A Philippine Territory Almost," authored by board member Alfred G. Gabot; supporting efforts to rename the Echo Park Library to Carlos Bulusan Library; spearheading various press conferences and covering community events in Southern California; and awarding a scholarship grant to a college-bound Filipino-American student.

"We invite our various publics to share our mission of serving our community the way we know best — helping inform our readers and viewers of latest developments in the community and in the homeland, and serving as facilitators for organizations to disseminate their projects and goals to our readers."
Dan E. Nino & Val G. Abelgas

In the Press

PGMG in the Philippine Post

Philippine Post

January 9, 2026  ·  Page 13

PGMG: A Night of Fun, Food and Camaraderie

The Philippine Post featured PGMG's holiday celebration — a five-hour evening of community spirit, Filipino food, raffles, and karaoke. Members and guests gathered for an evening of kwentuhan, kainan, kantahan at katuwaan.

The group also shared plans for an upcoming scholarship fund-raiser for Filipino journalism and mass communication students.
